Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that should keep you on the edge of your seat:

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre / Notable Element |
|---|-------|------|-----------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Psychological horror / supernatural |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Family trauma + occult dread |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social satire + psychological thriller |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Silence‑based tension |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight folk horror |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Viral curse + creeping dread |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal investigation |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological horror with a monster |
| 9 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Puritanic period horror |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found‑footage realism |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Japanese‑inspired cursed videotape |
|12 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑horror twist |
|13 | **Suspiria** (2018) | 2018 | Dance troupe + supernatural |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | Gothic atmosphere + twist |
|15 | **Poltergeist** | 1982 | Classic haunted house |

Feel free to pick based on what kind of scare you’re after—whether it’s psychological dread, supernatural chills, or a good old‑fashioned haunted house vibe. Happy watching!
